profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Credify Services
profile.summary:
Passionate about unraveling complex business challenges through clean, scalable code solutions, I bring over 4 years of experience in software development. Beyond coding, my expertise extends to collaborating with Product Owners, leading engineering teams, and crafting innovative solutions.

Outside of work, I thrive on strategic games like chess, Risk, Settlers of Catan, and Battleship, reflecting my competitive spirit in both professional and personal pursuits. Currently, I serve on the Board of Directors for First Refugee Ministries, a nonprofit dedicated to enriching our local community through essential services, notably our food pantry. My dedication to global service is equally important; my wife and I actively engage in international outreach, including a recent mission trip to Kenya in Summer 2023.

positions.title: Board Member
positions.description: I serve on the Board of Directors for First Refuge Ministries, a nonprofit based in Denton dedicated to providing essential services such as Dental, Medical, Counseling, and Food Pantry support to our community. Joining the board during a period of substantial organizational change has been a rewarding opportunity. Collaborating closely with our Director, Mark Roberts, I actively contribute to our mission, particularly through regular service in the food pantry.

positions.title: Director of Software Engineering
positions.description: I assumed the role of Director of Engineering during a comprehensive project overhaul. Leading a team of 20 we successfully launched a new project vastly improving clarity and scalability. A key challenge was managing evolving project expectations, especially as we uncovered and streamlined previously undocumented business processes and siloed information. After launching the new system I rebuilt the loan management logic for payment calculation to improve speed, simplicity and accuracy.

positions.title: Software Developer III
positions.description:
- Rewrote a legacy "BlackBox System" for lead purchasing into a streamlined lead funnel improving visibility and setting up for future expansion
- Participated in legacy LMS rewrite to improve business process and product functionality across the entire company.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Creative Problem Solving · PHP · Project Management

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Architected and maintained end-to-end web application using MERN stack while integrating 3rd party APIs to frontend business logic
- Hosted application on AWS EC2 utilizing linux, nginx, git, and PM2 to handle routing and deployment
- Designed and developed 15+ fully responsive custom screens including an analytics dashboard
- Setup application wide tests using Jest and Postman

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
- Assisted clients with level 1 and level 2 support requests and worked to strengthen client relations
- Implemented hardware refresh and workstation setup across multiple client sites and 100's of systems
- Managed heavy ticket loads and provided excellent service to clients at all times

educations.degreeName: Bachelor of Business Administration Management - BBA
